artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflections on the cylindrical body appear somewhat smeared and inconsistent with a rigid metallic or plastic surface, showing slight 'melting' or warping of the reflected environment.

The thumb pressing against the top of the lighter lacks clear definition; the edge of the thumb seems to blend slightly into the lighter's casing, suggesting minor fusion or boundary ambiguity common in AI generations.

The background face is heavily blurred. While this mimics depth-of-field, the features (eyes/mouth) have a slightly 'painted' or smoothed quality typical of generative models rather than optical blur.
